title: Definitive Meta-Analysis of RAMA/CAMA Experiments: Evidence Classification, Pooled Effect Sizes, and Publication Readiness
summary: Demo notebook performing a 6-phase meta-analysis of RAMA/CAMA experiments across 9 dependencies (iterations 2-3). Loads pre-extracted task results (18 tasks with per-seed metrics) from mini_demo_data.json, then runs: (1) evidence classification (GREEN/YELLOW/RED), (2) per-task Cohen's d with 10K bootstrap CIs, (3) DerSimonian-Laird random-effects meta-analysis under 4 scenarios, (4) subgroup and val-vs-test inflation analysis, (5) Avito safety assessment, (6) publication readiness scorecard. Includes forest plot and scenario comparison visualization. Key finding: GREEN-only pooled d=0.297 (fails d>0.4), publication not ready.
